test_case.name: Service Has No Endpoints (Label Selector Mismatch)
test_case.scenario_description: Kubernetes Service 'inventory-svc' in namespace 'fulfillment' is configured with label selector 'app=inventory-backend,tier=api', while the running Deployment pod 'inventory-service-5c6d7e8f9-t2w4y' (container 'inventory-api') has labels 'app=inventory-service,tier=backend'. Because zero pods match the selector, the Service's Endpoints object is empty ('Endpoints: <none>') and ingress requests fail with 'no endpoints available for service inventory-svc' (HTTP 503).
test_case.injected_fault: Label selector mismatch between Service 'inventory-svc' (app=inventory-backend) and Deployment pods (app=inventory-service) results in 0 active Service endpoints.
test_case.ground_truth_rca: Kubernetes Service 'inventory-svc' in namespace 'fulfillment' has zero active endpoints ('Endpoints: <none>', 'no endpoints available for service "inventory-svc"') due to a label selector mismatch ('app=inventory-backend,tier=api') against pod 'inventory-service-5c6d7e8f9-t2w4y' ('app=inventory-service,tier=backend').
